timeoutSeconds.description:
Maximum number of seconds the router could take to complete the request.
raises a TimeoutException if the elapsed time exceeds #timeoutSeconds.

title:
Random Router for {GenaiCore.Llm.Client}.
This router implements a random fallback strategy by attempting to call {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Client#model}(s)
randomly until one succeeds.
If none succeeds, it will return the list of errors encountered at every {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Client#model}.
If #timeoutSeconds is reached, it will return a TimeoutException.

Each model is internally retried up to 3 times with a 30 second timeout before moving to the next model.
NOTE: #timeoutSeconds takes precedence over the predefined timeout(i.e., 30 seconds) of model calls.
Examples of how #timeoutSeconds affects model fallback behavior:
1. Setting #timeoutSeconds to higher than 30 seconds ensures the router has sufficient time to try multiple models
   if the first model fails.
2. Setting #timeoutSeconds to less than 30 seconds may limit the router to only trying the first model
   before timing out.

@see GenaiCore.Llm.Router
name: GenaiCore.Llm.Router.Random
